description:
Found by fz-kdt.69's cold review. merge_callsite_activation
(semantic.rs:186-194) and merge_target_activation
(jobs/semantic.rs:1876-1890) each carry a 'same root+function, different
arrow -> keep current' arm that is UNREACHABLE: every caller matches targets
with same_call_target, which compares the full activation key including the
arrow. They read as arrow-coalescing sites and are not; if either went live
it would silently pin the first arrow observed at a callsite. Delete the arms
or make the impossibility explicit (match on the full key).
title: Two dead arrow-coalescing branches read as live and would pin first-observed arrows
